event.metadata_note: 2023 Marina Bay layout: 19 turns, 4.94 km, 62 laps.

evaluation_context.note: This replay is historical training-race telemetry, not a held-out evaluation or model prediction.

provenance.provider: FastF1 archived raw session and project-aligned telemetry cache

coordinate_system.aspect_ratio: Use equal x/y scale when drawing; source coordinates are not a projected official circuit map.

time_axis.race_elapsed_definition: session_time_sec - minimum LapStartTime for LapNumber 1 across race drivers

track_outline.method: One driver-lap trace only: original raw Source=pos points within the selected accurate clean lap interval [LapStartTime, LapStartTime + LapTime), sorted by SessionTime. No interpolation or driver concatenation.
track_outline.trace_note: Observed lap trace; sparse position sampling leaves small gaps near timing boundaries, so this is not surveyed circuit geometry.

replay.position_presence_rule: Emit position only when this sampled aligned row has finite X and Y; model IsValid is intentionally not used.
replay.missing_position_policy: Null means no finite cached position at this frame; do not carry the last position forward.
replay.resampling_provenance: Existing project alignment is a 4 Hz shared grid. X/Y are linearly interpolated only between finite source coordinates when their bracket gap is <=1.0 s, with no extrapolation. This exporter adds only deterministic frame stride sampling.
replay.optional_channels: lap_number, speed_kph, and is_pit_lap are read from the same aligned row; no model prediction is included.
replay.drivers_order: Each positions array is indexed by the drivers array order.
